title: Wanting a Buck and Bubbles bank account and a partnership contract
summary: He wanted to deposit the act's checks into an account in the name of Buck and Bubbles and held a partnership contract with Buck from Chicago in 1927.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Buck because I wanted to change the whole set-up with Buck and Bubbles with Nat Nazarro at this time and I couldn't get -- I wanted to establish an account at the bank under the name of Buck and Bubbles. That's what I wanted to do. Understand? And all the checks that Buck and Bubbles would get would go in the bank and would dispose of the money (inaudible). Well, it was hard for me to get Buck to do anything, and I didn't never have enough money. My half of the salary, my part of the salary wasn't sufficient to do nothing with. So what I had to do is take everybody's salary, take his salary and Nat's salary, all the money and use it. So I went and got the check.

See, this boy I had that was a valet that I brought from Cleveland, he would do all the going to the front to the manager to get an advance on the salary or he'd go do errands where necessary, keep the car clean. Now my point I'm trying to bring out to you now is that this boy -- I had a contract later, I

had a contract with Buck, partnership contract. I thought I needed it 'cause I want to sign his name along with mine. I couldn't do it without his okay and I couldn't take no check that's signed Buck and Bubbles and I don't get the money either. It had come to that, but the point of it is I got the partnership in Chicago during the time we were with Benny Goodman at the Congress Hotel in the year of 1927 I think it was.
